info.title: Citebase: get cited by AI
info.description: Plain-language SEO and AI-recommendation helper. Start with POST /run using tool get_playbook and name start, then follow it.

post.summary: Run one Citebase tool (use this one)
post.description: Runs one free Citebase tool and returns JSON {ok, tool, result}. First call: body {"tool":"get_playbook","arguments":{"name":"start"}} and follow that playbook. Tools and their arguments: get_playbook {name?} lists or reads guidelines; audit_site {url, max_pages?} checks a public website; quote_cost {items:[{job,units,requests?}]} prices paid data jobs and returns suggested_cap_usd; measure_recommendation_share {panel,runs,baseline?,current?,experiments?} computes how often AI recommends the brand; next_steps {audit?,report?,max_steps?} makes a plain to-do list; check_outreach_draft {to,subject,body,suppressed?,sent_today?,daily_cap?} checks an email before sending and never sends. Errors return {ok:false,error} with what to fix. Nothing is stored.

tool.description: Which Citebase tool to run, for example get_playbook. NOT an Apify Actor name.

arguments.description: Inputs for the chosen tool as JSON, for example {"name":"start"} or {"url":"https://example.com"}. Defaults to {}. Never put passwords or tokens here.

400.description: Bad input; the error says what to fix

post.summary: MCP JSON-RPC endpoint for MCP clients only (AI assistants should use /run)
